tagline: Detect coordinated manipulation with visible evidence and errors.
introduction: Help design Decode the Noise: evidence-based detection of propaganda, bots or coordinated bad actors, including benign coordination controls and measured false positives. Live deployment on Hostinger is a separate challenge requirement, not implied by this package.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Hostinger? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.description: Map a small website's requirements to the relevant Hostinger product documentation.

capabilities.title: Understand a DNS symptom
capabilities.description: Review a redacted DNS or HTTPS symptom and identify the next read-only check; a separate source-only helper compares bounded fictional A/CNAME snapshots without querying DNS.
inputs: redacted DNS records or error text

capabilities.title: Review launch readiness
capabilities.description: Build a short prelaunch checklist for a Hostinger-hosted site.

capabilities.title: Design Hostinger challenge support
capabilities.description: Coordination false-positive auditor. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Precision at stated false-positive rate on held-out coordinated and benign cases
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions
